source.title: An e6's guide to counterbuying versus each character
source.author: AShires

hero_counters.threat_profile: Heavy melee aggression, charge displacement, and high passive regeneration/sustain.

counter_items.reason: Reduces his innate health regeneration and life sustain when applying spirit damage.
Applies stacking anti-heal via weapon fire to counteract his lifesteal and regen.
Active healing reduction and current health percentage damage to melt tank pools.
Shortens the shoulder-charge stun and slow duration; it does not remove those effects immediately.
Punishes shotgun burst and point-blank trades.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Hook displacement, sticky bomb spirit burst, and sustained Hyper Beam channel.

counter_items.reason: Shortens Sticky Bomb debuff duration, but does not cleanse the bomb before detonation.
Drops an anvil to interrupt and cancel his Hyper Beam (Ult) channel.
Silences and disarms, preventing hook setups or instantly canceling ultimate channel.
Mitigates high scaling spirit damage from bombs and laser.
Instant blink to escape hook trajectories and break line of sight on the beam.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Singularity team black hole, heavy AoE knockup, and squad sustain.

counter_items.reason: Immunity to crowd control; prevents getting pulled into or locked inside Singularity.
Immediate hard silence and disarm to shut down Singularity channel from range.
Prevents him from chaining Quantum Entanglement or casting Singularity.
Cuts Rejuvenating Aurora area team healing.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Rooftop/airborne Rain of Arrows, piercing Charged Shot poke, and Guided Owl burst.

counter_items.reason: Knocks him directly out of the sky during Rain of Arrows, canceling his aerial flight.
Reduces massive burst from Charged Shot snipes and Guided Owl.
Grounds him and cancels Owl steering/channeling.
Improves bullet velocity to reliably hit him while hovering at long distance.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Stealth ambush, Sleep Dagger disable, and Bullet Dance channel.

counter_items.reason: 100% immunity to bullet damage; completely nullifies Bullet Dance (Ult).
Reflects rapid bullet damage during her spray and ultimate.
Interrupts and cancels Bullet Dance through an anvil stun from outside the radius.
Silences and disarms, canceling Bullet Dance instantly.
Shortens Sleep Dagger debuff duration, reducing the window for her follow-up.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Sustained Afterburn DoT, Catalyst damage amplification, and dive stun.

counter_items.reason: Shortens negative-effect duration; it does not purge Afterburn stacks or Catalyst amplification.
Passive duration reduction on fire ticks and slow debuffs.
Shuts down his core survivability engine (Spirit Lifesteal and Leech).
Prevents him from landing weapon fire to apply or refresh Afterburn stacks.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Sacrificial Essence Bomb poke, Life Drain tether sustain, and Soul Exchange reversal.

counter_items.reason: Severely reduces healing from Life Drain tether and Soul Exchange swaps.
Prevents her from executing Soul Exchange when dropped to critical HP.
Locks out Soul Exchange panic reversals and stops Life Drain channeling.
Mitigates heavy Essence Bomb burst and tether tick damage.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Vertical dive initiation, Ground Strike burst, and Death Slam kidnap.

counter_items.reason: Shortens applicable tether-related slow effects; it does not cleanse the tether itself.
Grants complete CC immunity against Death Slam throw and Ground Strike knockups.
Drops him out of the air while he maneuvers with Grapple.
Softens high base spirit damage from Ground Strike and Death Slam.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Turret zone control, sustained minigun fire, and Heavy Barrage rocket zoning.

counter_items.reason: Immediately interrupts Heavy Barrage rocket ultimate channel.
Cancels ultimate channel, disarms minigun, and silences turret deployment.
Ignores full ramp-up minigun damage during head-on trades.
Cuts Medicinal Spectre healing zone sustain for her and her push waves.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Burrow dive initiation, disarm poke, and Combo suppression ultimate.

counter_items.reason: Prevents Combo suppression lock-down.
Used by an ally to immediately interrupt Combo and save the pinned teammate.
Teammate drops anvil to knock them out of Combo channel.
Counters Scorn and Combo lifesteal pools.
Shortens applicable slow and disarm effects from Scorn and Sand Blast.

hero_counters.threat_profile: High mobility blink dives, Affliction DoT decay, and Satchel invulnerability stall.

counter_items.reason: Shortens applicable effects from Barrage and Affliction rather than purging their stacks.
Silences Pocket before they can enter Enchanter's Satchel or teleport with Cloak.
Stops escape rotations and prevents iframe stall execution.
Dampens heavy burst from Barrage and Satchel explosions.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Static Charge AoE stun curse and massive Storm Cloud zone denial channel.

counter_items.reason: Cancels Storm Cloud ultimate channel if Seven does not have Unstoppable active.
Silences Storm Cloud channel and prevents Static Charge casting.
Shortens Static Charge effect duration; it does not instantly remove the mark.
Dramatically reduces damage taken when caught inside Storm Cloud or Lightning Ball.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Bleed stacks, Bloodletting deferred damage mitigation, and Killing Blow executes.

counter_items.reason: Reduces Serrated Knives bleed duration, limiting how long the stacks remain.
Reduces Bloodletting flush clearing efficiency and spirit lifesteal.
Current-health shred to burn through his high effective health pool.
Protects against shotgun burst and Killing Blow resets during low-HP trades.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Flight snipes, Stake tether lockdown, Crow Familiar bleed, and Assassinate execution.

counter_items.reason: Swats her out of Flight, grounding her and canceling airborne advantage.
Shortens Stake and Crow Familiar debuff duration; it does not break the tether immediately.
Reduces standard scoped weapon damage and high-velocity snipe harass.
Dodge Assassinate red laser shots and close the gap on her flight perch.

hero_counters.threat_profile: The Cube invulnerability stall, Splatter poke, and CC-immune Goo Ball roll.

counter_items.reason: Silences before Cube can be popped, shutting down invulnerability saves.
Provides vertical or horizontal escape to evade Goo Ball rolling path.
Reduces the substantial health regeneration granted during The Cube.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Alchemical Flask slow/stamina drain, Binding Word root, and sustained bullet lifesteal.

counter_items.reason: Shortens Binding Word root duration rather than cleansing the tether.
Allows dashing outside Binding Word radius after taking Flask stamina drain.
Cuts Last Stand lifesteal pulse sustain during brawls.
Deters weapon trading during his shield and lifesteal duration.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Full Auto weapon DPS, Card Trick burst, and Telekinesis isolation stun.

counter_items.reason: Immunity to bullets; negates Full Auto activation and primary gun shred.
Punishes extreme fire rate during Full Auto.
Blocks Telekinesis lift and suppression.
Shortens stun and card-related negative-effect duration rather than cleansing them.

hero_counters.threat_profile: Power Slash spirit burst, Flying Strike grapple, and Shadow Transformation invulnerability.

counter_items.reason: Absorbs huge chunks of Spirit damage from Power Slash and Crimson Slash.
Silences Yamato before Shadow Transformation can be activated at low health.
Instant repositioning to break grapple tether lines and dodge Power Slash cones.
Suppresses healing and chips effective health once invulnerability ends.
